messages.content: What packages do you currently have ?

To make your stay more comfortable, I recommend:
• **Daily Breakfast** — A convenient buffet breakfast for every morning of your stay.
• **Late Checkout (until 3 PM)** — More time to enjoy the hotel before a late departure.
• **Spa & Wellness Package** — A relaxing complement to a multi-night stay.

You can add these in the booking panel.
I would like to add Daily Brakfast

**Cancellation**: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Cancellations within 48 hours are charged one night's rate.

**Check In**: Check-in is from 15:00; check-out is by 12:00.

**Children**: Children under 12 stay free when using existing bedding.
